disclaimer: No fictional recycler locations are listed. Authorisation status must be checked in the CPCB / state pollution control board register before handing over material.

streams.name: Solar PV modules
streams.handling: Take-back through the manufacturer's EPR route under the E-Waste (Management) Rules; crystalline silicon modules are recycled for glass, aluminium, copper and silicon.
streams.do_not: Do not sell to informal scrap dealers — modules contain lead, cadmium compounds and antimony in some technologies.

streams.name: Lithium-ion batteries
streams.handling: Return to the manufacturer or an authorised battery-waste recycler registered under the Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022.
streams.do_not: Do not puncture, crush or store damaged cells indoors; thermal runaway risk.

streams.name: Inverters and power electronics
streams.handling: Dismantle through an authorised e-waste recycler; capacitors and PCBs require controlled disposal.
streams.do_not: Do not landfill — heavy metals and electrolyte residue leach into soil.

streams.name: Cables and copper
streams.handling: Strip and recover copper and aluminium through registered metal recyclers; PVC insulation goes to authorised plastic recovery.
streams.do_not: Do not burn cable insulation to recover copper.
